metadata.description: Mission control for Claude Code: your builds, plan limits and tips in one place.

plugins.name: buildpilot
plugins.description: See every Claude Code build, how full each one's memory is, your 5-hour and weekly limits (with a forecast), and tips for right now. Local-only: nothing leaves your computer. Needs Node.js 18+ (22.13+ recommended); best on macOS (Windows/Linux preview).
